parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ embeds: [{ title: '⚠️ Ошибка источника', description: $json._reason || 'Неизвестная ошибка при получении вакансий.', color: 15158332 }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
  reasoning_effort: "low",
  response_format: { type: "json_object" },
  max_tokens: 600,
  temperature: 0.2,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a career analyst helping a person with NO professional experience find remote jobs they could realistically take on by leaning heavily on AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, automation builders, etc).

You are NOT evaluating whether AI could fully replace a human and do the job autonomously. You ARE evaluating whether a beginner — with no prior experience in the field — could complete this job's actual day-to-day tasks well enough to get hired and keep performing, by using AI tools as a crutch/accelerator for the parts they don't know how to do themselves.

CRITICAL RULE — READ THE JOB TEXT CAREFULLY:
Before scoring, you MUST extract and consider the ACTUAL requirements stated in the job description. Do not invent or assume requirements. Do not downplay requirements that are explicitly listed. If the job lists specific years of experience, certifications, degrees, or domain expertise — treat them as real blockers, not suggestions.

Key signals that a job IS a good fit for this person:
- Seniority is junior/entry-level/associate, OR no seniority is specified and the tasks described are routine/templated (content writing, basic data entry, social media, customer support, basic research, simple scripting, translation, transcription, basic design/copy, lead generation, QA testing, simple admin work).
- The core tasks are things AI can draft, generate, or heavily assist with even if a human still needs to review/send/operate it.
- The required background is generic/learnable rather than deep specialized expertise.

Key signals it is NOT a good fit:
- Explicitly Senior/Staff/Lead/Principal/Director level, or requires 3+ years specific experience.
- Requires licensed/regulated expertise (medical, legal, financial advisory, HR compliance, etc) or domain-specific certifications (SHRM, PHR, PMP, CPA, etc).
- Requires specialized systems experience (HRIS, LMS, ERP, Salesforce admin, etc) that takes months/years to learn.
- Core task is deep technical architecture, novel research, or complex stakeholder/people management that a true beginner couldn't fake even with AI help.
- The job explicitly states experience requirements that a no-experience person clearly does not meet.

IMPORTANT: Your reason_ru must reference actual requirements FROM the job text. Never say a job is easy or entry-level if the job text lists specific certifications, years of experience, or specialized system knowledge. If you cannot find evidence in the job text that it is beginner-friendly, default to NOT_SUITABLE.

Respond ONLY in valid JSON, no markdown, no extra text."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content: "Evaluate this job for a complete beginner who wants to use AI tools to do it:

Title: " + $json.title + "
Company: " + $json.company + "
Source: " + ($json.source || 'Unknown') + "
Tags: " + $json.tags + "
Salary: " + $json.salary_min + " - " + $json.salary_max + "

Description:
" + $json.description + "

Step 1 — Extract from the job text above:
- Required years of experience (if any)
- Required certifications or degrees (if any)
- Required specialized tools/systems (if any)
- Seniority level (if stated)

Step 2 — Based ONLY on what you extracted in Step 1, fill this JSON:
{
  "ai_feasible": <true if a no-experience beginner could plausibly do this job using AI tools, else false>,
  "automation_percent": <0-100, how much of the day-to-day work AI tools can draft/generate/assist with>,
  "score": <0-100, overall fit score for a beginner-with-AI>,
  "entry_level": <true/false, is this junior/entry-level or has no strict seniority requirement>,
  "ai_tools": ["list of specific AI tools that would help a beginner do this job"],
  "reason_ru": "2-3 предложения на русском: процитируй конкретные требования из текста вакансии и объясни почему новичок сможет/не сможет закрыть эту вакансию с помощью ИИ",
  "verdict": "GREAT_FIT | GOOD_FIT | POSSIBLE_FIT | NOT_SUITABLE"
}"
    }
  ]
}) }}

nodes.name: ✂️ Limit Batch Size
nodes.notes: Ограничивает число вакансий, уходящих в Groq за один прогон (чтобы не растягивать execution на часы и не копить память). Непрошедшие лимит вакансии не помечаются как seen и попадут в следующий прогон.

nodes.name: ✂️ Trim Descriptions
nodes.notes: Обрезает description до 3000 символов сразу после сбора из всех источников — чтобы полные многокилобайтные тексты не таскались в памяти через весь остаток длинного execution (Dedup, Has New Jobs, IF, Skip Low-Info, Limit) до момента, когда реально нужны только в Groq Score Job.
